selectionRule: Ten reference graduate programs per specialty, selected by triangulation of official curricula, research environment, professional signals, discipline rankings as context, and transferability; not an absolute ranking.
libraryRule: A book is a candidate until its source, edition, rights, jurisdiction and curricular use are verified; no full copyrighted book ingestion is implied.
nextGates: Human academic review of program and bibliography selection
Official verification of current Peruvian norms and UNI references
Rights and licensing review before ingestion
Specialist review for high-risk structural, sanitary, electrical, fire and contractual content
Learning assessment before any capability is marked demonstrated
